description: Mamba: Gated State Space Model (Mamba) linear attention replacement (Production-Hardened).  Implements a gated selective state-space projection that is a drop-in replacement for a standard Multi-Head Attention layer, operating in strictly O(L) time and space with respect to sequence length, with LoRA adapters, multi-architecture weight extraction, causal masking, RoPE support, and nested encoder b

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
